verdict.rationale: Cline's docs describe cron-scheduled agents through the hub that persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session, and the native app can 'schedule routines'. Trigger-style runs come from headless execution inside GitHub Actions, GitLab or any pipeline, and fully autonomous auto-approve/YOLO modes support unattended fixes such as 'run tests and fix failures'. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled/always-on agents, deeper documentation of the scheduling hub (setup, monitoring, failure handling), and explicit event-trigger support beyond CI pipelines (e.g. issue- or alert-driven fix runs).
